summary_1line: After vowing to fight for Duryodhana, Karna arrives at the battlefield and mourns Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna steps down from his golden chariot and approaches Bhishma lying on a bed of arrows, tears in his eyes.
Bhishma lies motionless on a vast bed of arrows across the battlefield, resembling the sun fallen from the sky.
Karna prepares for battle as attendants bring his jeweled armor, golden banner, and wind‑swift horses beside a shining chariot.
